candidate_title: Assisted Declarative Process Creation from Natural Language Descriptions

review_output.decision_rationale: Title explicitly references natural language; abstract mentions NLP techniques for identifying roles, activities, and constraints and for creating declarative process models from text. This shows NLP-based extraction/creation from natural language text, aligning with Stage 1 criteria. Therefore, the evidence supports inclusion at Stage 1 and defers no knowledge to Stage 2.
